_doc: Category 7 Oils, Condiments, and Specialty Foods compiler config for the eight scope-locked rows. The four unresolved broad rows (condiments-general, snacks-general, canned-foods-general, mixed-meals-prepared-foods) are intentionally excluded until their locked taxonomy split or governing product basis is resolved. Initial numeric values are government limits only; a control cell records mandatory testing without inventing a number where no sovereign maximum exists.

Pb.control: No exact sovereign lead maximum is loaded for this product form. Total Pb remains mandatory on every lot; the cell cannot receive an occurrence-derived number.

Cd.control: No exact sovereign cadmium maximum is loaded for this product form. Total Cd remains mandatory on every lot; the cell cannot receive an occurrence-derived number.

tAs.control: No exact sovereign total-arsenic maximum is loaded for this product form. Total As remains mandatory and elevated results require speciation.
tAs.reference_method: Total As by ICP-MS; iAs by HPLC-ICP-MS on an elevated result.

iAs.control: No separate sovereign inorganic-arsenic maximum is loaded for this non-rice product. Total As is mandatory; elevated results trigger iAs speciation, and the iAs result is evaluated within the total-As control.

tHg.control: No exact sovereign total-mercury maximum is loaded for this product form. Total Hg remains mandatory on every lot.
tHg.reference_method: Total Hg by EPA 7473 or ICP-MS.

MeHg.control: This non-marine row has no methylmercury bioaccumulation pathway. Total Hg is mandatory and bounds MeHg; products containing fish or another marine ingredient must route to the applicable seafood/speciation standard.
MeHg.reference_method: Total Hg screen; MeHg by GC-ICP-MS / HPLC-ICP-MS if a marine ingredient or anomalous total-Hg result creates a pathway.

Ni.control: No exact sovereign nickel maximum is loaded for this product form. Total Ni remains mandatory and is reported as surveillance, not converted into an occurrence-selected certification value.

Sn.control: Tin is primarily a tinplate-migration analyte. Non-canned products require total-Sn surveillance and packaging verification; canned versions route to the canned-food standard.
Sn.reference_method: Total Sn by ICP-MS plus packaging declaration.

Al.control: No exact sovereign finished-product aluminium maximum is loaded for this product form. Total Al remains mandatory, with additive, processing-aid, soil, and equipment sources investigated.

Cr.control: No exact sovereign total-chromium maximum is loaded for this product form. Total Cr remains mandatory and any elevated result triggers species investigation.

Cr-VI.control: Any total-Cr result at or above 100 ug/kg triggers Cr(VI) speciation, and any quantifiable Cr(VI) fails certification.
Cr-VI.reference_method: Cr(VI) by validated alkaline extraction and IC-ICP-MS (EPA 3060A/EPA 6800 or equivalent).
